# @dxtmisha/mcp

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration and tool provider for the DXT UI design system.

Implements Model Context Protocol endpoints to expose DXT UI component documentation, constructors, design tokens, and AI prompt tools directly to AI coding assistants and IDEs.

## Key Modules & Classes

- [Mcp](src/classes/Mcp.ts): Main MCP server implementation handling tools, resources, and prompt definitions via `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`.
- [McpItemAbstract](src/classes/McpItemAbstract.ts): Base abstract class for managing MCP item collections (Tools, Resources, Prompts).
- [library.ts](src/library.ts): Auto-generated library export barrel (managed via `dxt-library`).
- [classes](src/classes): MCP handler and protocol controller classes.
- [functions](src/functions): Protocol formatting and validation helpers.

## Development Rules

- Do NOT manually edit `src/library.ts`. Run `npm run library` to regenerate exports.

## Optional

- [ai-description.md](ai-description.md): Package architecture and exposition rules.
- [package.json](package.json): Package dependencies and scripts.
